title: Gideon
textBlocks:
Hello Bravehearts
Today you will meet 
Gideon
who God appeared to
And told him that he was chosen to help the Israelites

BUT GIDEON WASN’T VERY BRAVE - HE WAS RATHER SCARED
and didn’t trust the Lord

The angel of the Lord appeared to Gideon and Gideon made him some food as an offering
He made bread and cooked a broth of goat meat

The angel made him put it on a rock and the angel of the Lord touch it with his staff
FIRE ATE THE MEAT & BREAD

But Gideon still wanted more signs from the Lord
SO HE ASKED FOR 2 MORE SIGNS

SIGN 1
The wool must be wet and the ground dry
SIGN 2
The wool my be dry and the ground must be wet
NOW GIDEON WAS READY TO GO TO BATTLE TO FREE THE ISRAELITES
We must TRUST the LORD and be BRAVE and STRONG

Today’s Activity
BUILD A TOWER AND SMASH IT DOWN
The Lord told Gideon to smash down the altar and poles used to worship other gods
Colour in and glue some cotton wool on your picture

Talk to Jesus
Dear Lord Jesus
Thank you for making the world
Thank you for loving me and looking after me
Please help me to trust you
Amen
